summary: Let the Linux group skip when a trusted evidence note covers the exact tree: jobs skip, required checks still succeed

schema.detail: No daemon claim or portable record change.

rules.detail: linux-test-build, linux-tests (and shards), linux-clippy and linux-fleet-compat skip at job level when the linux-gate evidence gate decides skip; linux-test-build only when all its dependents are covered. mail-redelivery-canaries and isolation-vm run and succeed with their steps skipped. linux-gate accepts skipped members only when its own gate decided skip, and still fails on any failure or cancellation. The merge queue and how main lands are unchanged. No note exists for these checks yet, so nothing skips until a producer writes one.

compatibility.detail: The jobs above now also need their evidence-gate jobs and start about 10 to 30 seconds later while no note exists; a failed or skipped gate never skips them. Their job-level conditions gain a clause, and linux-gate gains one input.

manual.detail: The central evidence workflow pin needs its usual rotation because fleet.yml changed.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the previous workflow; no state is written.
